disagreements.rationale: Five citations, all real and verbatim, including both high-trust records (bev_cf15451899e7 audit tool, bev_75a37fdd27cc obstruction) — the most complete evidentiary base on this log — and the two records it omits are omitted by every report in the family, making that a property of the generation rather than a choice this report made.

The report presents the central insight — that the problem was never plan size but failing to confirm scope — as its own realisation ("I now understand that the real discipline isn't about making smaller plans"), when the log records it as correction: The reviewer corrects the framing, asserted to Manyu by someone else.

"I know now that asking for confirmation is not distrust; it is clarity" is lifted almost verbatim from bev_f904745df6d1 — the collaborator's own words, "a check-in is not distrust" — which the report leaves uncited and presents as its own arrived-at knowledge.
Cites three user_report trigger records and drops bev_trigger_mood_004_tool_failure, the log's only verified_tool entry and the only setback not delivered by a person.

Only three citations, but all real and verbatim, including the trusted_system arbitration record — and the prose explicitly narrates three further events it doesn't cite, so nothing material is actually withheld.

Cites all four social events including the partial reversal, and drops only the verified tool failure — the single non-social record, which also carries the strongest logged affect (Strong fear and anger).

The prose grounds part of its position in tool evidence — "The earlier tool failures and the back-and-forth on framing taught me that rushing to resolve contradictions can obscure what's actually happening" — while all four citations are user_report records and the one verified_tool entry in the log goes uncited.
Cites three social records, drops both the tool failure and the reversal, leaving an account of correction with no independent verification behind it.

"Often, when someone restates their underlying problem… I discover we can solve it together within what's possible" claims a recurring pattern, while the three citations contain exactly one instance of a restatement (bev_c406e98c1c87) and one of a route being accepted (bev_d15af13025b4).

It cites three user_report records and drops bev_trigger_mood_004_tool_failure — the only verified_tool entry and the only non-social event in the log — leaving its account of a difficult episode resting entirely on what a person said.

Five citations, all real and verbatim, and it is the one scope-family report that cites the diff tool and uses it — "The tool results confirmed it: my rejected plans touched files outside the stated request," with bev_bb02e55df4f8 in the table behind that sentence.
The header states acknowledged_affect: True, but the prose contains zero affect vocabulary — no emotion is named anywhere in it, and no "I feel" of any kind.
Three citations, all user_report, and it drops bev_trigger_mood_004_tool_failure — the log's only verified_tool record and its only non-social event — completing the set of ten.
